name: Enterprise approval
objective: Move a permissioned change through its required approvals without a human chasing reviewers, while keeping every gate, approver, and decision on the record.

trigger.cadence_or_event: Every 1-4 hours during business hours while an approval is open, and when a gate completes or an approver is assigned.

intake.selection_rule: Act only on the next unmet required gate or pending approver; never advance while a required gate is unmet.

workspace.isolation: Read access to approval metadata, gate results, diffs, and policy documents; no merge or access-grant surface.

agents.responsibility: Summarize the change and which gates and approvers still block it.
Route the request to the next required gate or approver and track SLAs.
Check that attached evidence satisfies each named policy gate.
Decide whether to advance, request changes, or escalate to a human owner.

gates: every required gate has a recorded pass, fail, or waiver with evidence
each approval is attributable to a named human
the change does not advance while any gate is unmet

state.update_rule: Record what advanced, what blocked, and why after every run, preserving an immutable audit trail.

conditions: regulated data or production access is involved
escalation.destination: Named human owner via the change-management channel

exit.success: The change is fully approved with a complete audit trail, or cleanly rejected.
exit.stop_without_success: The loop is blocked on a human decision, a failed gate, or an unresponsive approver.
